description: This file defines the AppState class, a global application state manager for a Flutter app. It holds cached entity counts, the active user, and provides methods to load initial data, update state, and refresh the dashboard. It interacts with a database via DAOs for users, workouts, and goals.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A change notifier class managing the application's global state, including the active user and counts of workouts and goals.

methods.name: loadInitial
methods.description: Initializes the app state by loading the first user, total workouts, and completed goals from the database, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: setActiveUser
methods.description: Sets the active user and notifies listeners.

methods.name: refreshDashboard
methods.description: Refreshes workout and goal counts from the database, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: addWorkout
methods.description: Inserts a new workout into the database and refreshes the dashboard.

methods.name: addGoal
methods.description: Inserts a new goal into the database and refreshes the dashboard.

methods.name: toggleGoal
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a goal, updates it in the database, and refreshes the dashboard.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates or inserts the user in the database, sets as active user, and notifies listeners.
